correctness.rationale: Line-graph independent sets are exactly root-graph matchings. Partitioning by use of the unique cut vertex yields the stated exhaustive polynomial. The formal generating functions prove that precisely the lengths divisible by 3 yield simple zeros of the path factors, and their derivative-to-endpath ratios are positive reciprocals of integers; the resulting leading coefficient is a nonzero same-sign sum, so no cancellation is possible. All boundaries r>=1 and lengths>=3 are handled. Independently constructed matching enumerations agree coefficientwise on 126 graphs, and 336 additional equal-length cases check root order and leading coefficient; finite checks are not used to prove the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification in a nonforest family directly motivated by the new root-multiplicity program. It reveals that the exact vanishing order is insensitive to the magnitudes of all cycle lengths, depending only on how many are divisible by three, and gives a nonzero leading coefficient and an all-coefficient enumerator. It supplies arbitrary multiplicities on connected cactus-line graphs and a precise mixed-residue boundary distinct from known homogeneous friendship examples; this nontrivial noncancellation principle is not a mere coefficient lookup.
